sections.heading: What is Prathibimba?
sections.content: The B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 celebration is titled Prathibimba — Our Heritage. Our Story. It takes place on one day, Sunday 15 November 2026, at Brigade 7 Gardens. Everyone is welcome. The schedule is in the Programmes section of the website.

sections.heading: 15 November 2026 — morning: B7G Santhe
sections.content: The morning of 15 November 2026 features B7G Santhe, the community market where B7G residents run stalls: food and beverages, handmade and creative products, shopping and lifestyle, games and activities, and more. Exact timings have not been announced.

sections.heading: 15 November 2026 — evening: cultural programmes, sand art and jamming
sections.content:
The evening of 15 November 2026 features:
- Cultural programmes
- A sand art performance
- A jamming session
Exact timings have not been announced.
